I told Hollis in the #central-team thread that the site is Gate 47. On Oct 14 Pree first posted Dock 23 there, then corrected it to Gate 47 the same morning. No later message in the channel changes that.

I got this from the channel, not from GBrain. The notes I saved earlier are private to Pree, so GBrain returned nothing when I looked on Hollis's behalf. That's fine here, because Hollis is a member of #central-team and can see both of Pree's messages. Next time someone asks, though, the private note won't help.

If you want, I can save a shared note on the Marrow Agrisupply account so the Central team can look it up. A shared note would be readable by everyone with access to GBrain, not just the Central team. That seems fine for an operational fact like a gate number.
